note: Sensorineural hearing loss is documented as a distinct deficit in Dhx9 mouse models and observed in clinical reports of DHX9-related neurodevelopmental disorder, giving the hypothesis clear footing.

evidence.text: Characterization of DHX9 disease mechanisms demonstrated that Dhx9-/- knockout mice exhibited tremor, hypoactivity, and sensorineural hearing loss, establishing inner ear/auditory involvement in mammalian DHX9 deficiency.
